# ToolDB

> ToolDB is a curated directory of AI tools, software, and developer resources. Discover, compare, and explore tools by category, platform, pricing model, and use case.

## Website

- https://tooldb.org

## Main sections

- https://tooldb.org/tools — Browse all tools
- https://tooldb.org/categories — Browse categories

## About

- https://tooldb.org/about
- https://tooldb.org/contact

## Legal

- https://tooldb.org/privacy-policy
- https://tooldb.org/terms-of-service
- https://tooldb.org/affiliate-disclosure

## Data

ToolDB provides structured information about software tools, including:

- Name
- Description
- Categories
- Platforms
- Pricing model
- Features
- Official website
- Related tools

The goal of ToolDB is to help users discover and compare software tools through curated and structured information.
